-- make 7 job gestures readable without new parts, tweens, remotes or frame loops.
-- Normalized time is server-cast-driven; no server damage/skill timing changes.
local function smoothstep(t:number):number
 local x=math.clamp(t,0,1)
 return x*x*(3-2*x)
end
local function motionProfile(t:number,slot:string):(number,number)
 local u=math.clamp(t,0,1)
 -- Skill A is only 0.26s: its old 0.12*duration=31ms hold may be skipped at 25fps.
 -- Extend just A's impact silhouette to 0.26*0.26s=67.6ms (mobile-friendly).
 -- Longer B/C skills keep their previous pacing without changing server timing.
 local strikeEnd=(slot=="A") and .36 or .42
 local holdEnd=(slot=="A") and .62 or .54
 if u<.18 then
  return -.20*smoothstep(u/.18),0
 elseif u<strikeEnd then
  local strike=smoothstep((u-.18)/(strikeEnd-.18))
  return -.20+1.20*strike,strike
 elseif u<holdEnd then
  return 1,1
 else
  local recover=1-smoothstep((u-holdEnd)/(1-holdEnd))
  return recover,recover
 end
end
